values: 瓦尔克为手枪填装子弹后，逐个射击面前的敌人，造成伤害和眩晕。
Walker fires at enemies in front one by one after loading bullets, dealing damage and stunning them.
瓦尔克给他的手枪填装6发子弹，随机射向面前的敌人，优先射击本次施放中尚未射击过的敌人。每发子弹造成50% ATK外加目标最大生命值5% + 1%的伤害（外加伤害不超过60% ATK），并使目标眩晕1.5 + 0.2秒。对同一目标的后续命中造成50%的伤害。

Walker loads his revolver with 6 bullets, randomly shooting at enemies in front, prioritizing enemies not hit during this cast. Each bullet deals 50% ATK damage plus 5% + 1% of the target's max HP (the bonus damage is up to 60% ATK), stunning the target for 1.5 + 0.2s. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 50% damage.
面前的敌人包含被技能“悬赏追击”悬赏的目标时，在射击过所有面前的敌人之后，剩余的子弹会全部射向被悬赏的敌人。
When the enemies in front include a target marked with Bounty Pursuit, the remaining bullets will be directed at the targeted enemy after shooting all others.
瓦尔克的普通攻击强化为范围伤害。
Walker's normal attacks are enhanced to cause AoE damage.
瓦尔克的普通攻击发射3枚可以穿透敌人的子弹，对前方一定范围内的敌人造成伤害，并且主目标总是会受到3枚子弹的伤害，每枚子弹造成34% + 6% ATK伤害。瓦尔克的普通攻击范围无法扩大。

Walker shoots 3 penetrative bullets using normal attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the frontal area. His main target will always receive damage from 3 bullets, each with 34% + 6% ATK damage. Walker's normal attack range cannot be buffed any further.
普通攻击暴击时，对伤害到的敌人造成0.125秒的眩晕。
Walker's normal attacks stun the enemies for 0.125s upon dealing critical hits.
每枚子弹的伤害提升至37% + 6% ATK。
Increases each bullet's damage dealt to 37% + 6% ATK.
每枚子弹的伤害提升至40% + 6% ATK。
Increases each bullet's damage dealt to 40% + 6% ATK.
瓦尔克优先攻击累计输出最高的敌人的悬赏令，期间获得增益效果。
Walker prioritizes attacking the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, during which he gains a buff.
战斗开始后第10秒，瓦尔克领取此时累计输出最高的敌人的悬赏令。领取悬赏令后，瓦尔克受到的伤害下降18% + 5%，优先攻击被悬赏的敌人，并且对其造成的伤害提升25% + 5%。被悬赏的敌人被击败时，瓦尔克直至战斗结束提升5 + 3点暴击，至多提升15 + 9点。

Walker claims the bounty on the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt 10s after a battle starts. Walker prioritizes attacking this enemy upon claiming the bounty, increasing his damage dealt by 25% + 5% and reducing his damage taken by 18% + 5%. Walker gains 5 + 3 Crit boost (up to 15 + 9) till the battle ends when the targeted enemy is defeated.
瓦尔克领取悬赏令时，使用手枪对其连开3枪，每枪造成50% ATK外加目标已损失生命值4%的伤害（外加伤害不超过25% ATK）。

Upon claiming the bounty, Walker fires 3 shots at the enemy who is marked with it. Each shot deals 50% ATK damage plus the damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP (the bonus damage is up to 25% ATK).
被悬赏的敌人被击败后，瓦尔克可以再次领取悬赏令。
Walker can claim the bounty again after the previous targeted enemy is defeated.
瓦尔克领取悬赏令时，使用手枪对其连开3枪，每枪造成55% ATK外加目标已损失生命值4%的伤害（外加伤害不超过25% ATK）。

Upon claiming the bounty, Walker fires 3 shots at the enemy who is marked with it. Each shot deals 55% ATK damage plus the damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP (the bonus damage is up to 25% ATK).
Increases Crit DMG Boost during battle.
战斗中，自身的暴击增幅提升30点。
Increases Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle.
战斗中，自身的暴击增幅提升40点。
Increases Crit DMG Boost by 40 during battle.
战斗中，自身的暴击增幅提升50点。
Increases Crit DMG Boost by 50 during battle.
瓦尔克在战斗开始时丢出榴弹，造成范围伤害和眩晕。
Walker throws grenades at the beginning of a battle, dealing AoE damage and stunning his enemies.
战斗开始时，瓦尔克朝3名敌人各丢出1枚榴弹，然后掏出手枪来引爆榴弹。榴弹被引爆时，使1格扇形区域内的敌人眩晕2秒、护甲在15秒内下降10%并受到140% ATK伤害。多枚榴弹命中同一目标时，只生效1次。

Walker throws a grenade at each of the 3 enemies when a battle starts, then uses his revolver to detonate the grenade. The enemies within a 1-tile arc will be stunned for 2s, taking 140% ATK damage and losing 10% Phys DEF in 15s upon grenades exploding. The above skill effect only takes effect once when multiple grenades hit the same target.
还能使敌人在15秒内下降10点抗暴击。
Reduces the enemies' Crit Resist by 10 in 15s.
瓦尔克首次对被悬赏目标造成伤害时获得护盾。
Walker gains a shield when dealing damage to the bounty target for the first time.
瓦尔克对被悬赏的敌人首次造成伤害时，获得最大生命值20%的护盾，护盾持续至被悬赏的敌人被击败。
Walker gains a shield equal to 20% of max HP when dealing damage to the targeted enemy for the first time. The shield lasts till the target is defeated.
瓦尔克提高20点暴击，普通攻击对被悬赏的敌人造成暴击时，造成的伤害提升60%，并且这次伤害还附带100点生命汲取。
Walker increases his Crit by 20. When his normal attack deals critical damage to an enemy carrying a bounty, increases the damage of this attack by 60% and grants it 100 Life Drain.
